atlas: BigBrain, Merker-stained histology, in ICBM152 2009 nonlinear asymmetric space
version: BigBrain 2015 release, registration by Xiao et al. 2019
licence_note: The down-sampled BigBrain volumes of this OSF dataset are CC BY 4.0 with the consent of the MNI and Forschungszentrum Jülich; BigBrain itself remains CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (README of the dataset).
citation: Amunts K. et al. 2013, BigBrain: an ultrahigh-resolution 3D human brain model, Science 340:1472-1475, https://doi.org/10.1126/science.1235381; Xiao Y. et al. 2019, An accurate registration of the BigBrain dataset with the MNI PD25 and ICBM152 atlases, Scientific Data 6:210, https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-019-0217-0
derived: Converted to 8 bits; slide (white) and voxels without data set to 0 so that they are transparent; centred like the Julich-Brain label volume (same grid). Changes made by SYNAPTICA. Not combined with any atlas file.
